notes.title: Patch 0416
notes.content:
We've released a patch with 2 important bug fixes:

1. Fixed a performance issue that caused the game to render at a higher framerate than intended and would use far too much CPU/GPU in the process. Performance should be much smoother now.

2. Fixed an aspect ratio problem on super widescreen monitors that would cause the game to cut off parts off the top/bottom of the screen.
